title: Include geo filtering in currentRefinedValues

comments.body:
> I'm not sure how this should be done though, as displaying lat/lng coordinates does not make sense.

Yes, if the go-to solution is always to use a specific template then your workaround (is it working?) seems good.

Right now the widget doesn't recognize `_geoloc` as a special value to display geo search information, so that would be the minimum needed change.

To work around this there's the possibility to declare a fake facet attribute in the settings and change its value. That works well, and then the template idea works well, but it's very hacky :)

Ok so the issue here is that the currentRefinedValues is not reading generic searchParameters, only refinements: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blame/e81c320a0f025332c9fdbb4bb0177eada54216cd/src/lib/utils.js#L159

geoloc is only a searchParameter, what we could do is that if we find a match for the name of the attribute inside the searchParameters then we accept it. So that you do not have to declare a fake facet.
That sounds like a good compromise @vvo  :)
